description: Import a drawpoint description through the MassFlow file-selection dialog instead of a filename argument.
notes: Not in the MassFlow manual — this command has no page in the 9.7 doc tree. Syntax below is read from the live 9.7.47 binary.

Interactive only: the command opens a modal dialog and waits for a file to be chosen in the MassFlow window, so it cannot be driven from a data file or from an automation bridge. Use `massflow drawpoint import` there.
File format: see reference topic 'file-formats draw-points'.
